description: This is a C header file defining the interface for help and command-related functionalities within a command-line project. It includes function declarations for listing commands, loading command lists, help for unknown commands, and configuration listing helpers, as well as data structures related to command names.

methods.name: cmdnames_release
methods.description: Releases memory associated with a cmdnames structure.

methods.name: list_common_cmds_help
methods.description: Displays help information for common commands.

methods.name: list_all_cmds_help
methods.description: Displays help for all commands, with options to show external commands and aliases.

methods.name: list_guides_help
methods.description: Displays help related to guides.

methods.name: list_user_interfaces_help
methods.description: Displays help for user interfaces.

methods.name: list_developer_interfaces_help
methods.description: Displays help for developer interfaces.

methods.name: list_all_main_cmds
methods.description: Lists all main commands into a string list.

methods.name: list_all_other_cmds
methods.description: Lists all other commands into a string list.

methods.name: list_cmds_by_category
methods.description: Lists commands filtered by a category.

methods.name: list_cmds_by_config
methods.description: Lists commands filtered by configuration.

methods.name: help_unknown_cmd
methods.description: Provides a help message for an unknown command.

methods.name: load_command_list
methods.description: Loads a list of commands with a given prefix.

methods.name: load_builtin_commands
methods.description: Loads built-in commands into a command list.

methods.name: add_cmdname
methods.description: Adds a command name to a cmdnames structure.

methods.name: exclude_cmds
methods.description: Excludes certain commands from a command list, expects excluded list to be sorted.

methods.name: is_in_cmdlist
methods.description: Checks if a command is in the given command list.

methods.name: list_commands
methods.description: Displays commands from main and other command cmdnames.

methods.name: get_version_info
methods.description: Retrieves version info into a strbuf, with an option to show build options.

methods.name: help_unknown_ref
methods.description: Provides suggested corrections for mistyped command references and terminates.

methods.name: list_config_advices
methods.description: Lists configuration advice options.

methods.name: list_config_color_branch_slots
methods.description: Lists color configuration for branch slots.

methods.name: list_config_color_decorate_slots
methods.description: Lists color configuration for decorate slots.

methods.name: list_config_color_diff_slots
methods.description: Lists color configuration for diff slots.

methods.name: list_config_color_grep_slots
methods.description: Lists color configuration for grep slots.

methods.name: list_config_color_interactive_slots
methods.description: Lists color configuration for interactive slots.

methods.name: list_config_color_status_slots
methods.description: Lists color configuration for status slots.

methods.name: list_config_color_sideband_slots
methods.description: Lists color configuration for sideband slots.

methods.name: list_config_fsck_msg_ids
methods.description: Lists file system check message IDs.

methods.name: void list_config_item(struct string_list * list,const char * prefix,const char * str)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: void mput_char(char c,unsigned int num)
methods.description: unavailable

ctags.name: list_config_item
ctags.signature: (struct string_list * list,const char * prefix,const char * str)

ctags.pattern: /^static inline void mput_char(char c, unsigned int num)$/
